summary: Gives a framework for deploying IP multicast in an MPLS environment. It describes issues in applying MPLS to multicast, the pros and cons of existing multicast routing protocols in that setting, and how different layer 2 technologies and label distribution approaches affect it.

eli5.summary: Sending one video to many viewers is tricky when your network moves traffic using labels. This overview explains the trouble spots and choices of mixing the two.

questions: how does ip multicast work with mpls
what are the issues of multicast in mpls
